data.title: So they are suppressing our history again? – a pseudohistorical bestseller
data.excerpt: A book entitled Tajné dejiny Slovenska, Slovenov a Sloveniek by Oskar Cvengrosch drew the attention of a great many people interested in our history – and an hour of leafing through it was enough to make us want to shelve it under fantasy. Here we point to a review by archaeologists and historians who read the whole of it.
data.metaTitle: So they are suppressing our history again? – a review
data.metaDescription: A critical look at the book Tajné dejiny Slovenska, Slovenov a Sloveniek by Oskar Cvengrosch and at the way it relates to the real past of Slovakia.

children.text: Some time ago a book entitled
Tajné dejiny Slovenska, Slovenov a Sloveniek (The Secret History of Slovakia, of Slovak Men and Slovak Women)

by Oskar Cvengrosch appeared on the shelves of Slovak bookshops and attracted the attention of a great many people interested in our history. After about an hour of “cursory” leafing through it I put it back on the shelf in horror – although I felt like moving it to the fantasy literature section. The author cannot be serious!

Since I am neither a historian nor an archaeologist, I will not presume to write a review of the book. All the more pleased was I today when, on the HISTORYWEB portal, with which we have been working together for some time, I came across a review by specialists (archaeologists and historians) who read the entire book, for which they have my sincere condolences. Perhaps this review will save you from throwing away your hard-earned money ....

blocks.text: What is the book Tajné dejiny Slovenska, Slovenov a Sloveniek like? When I began work on this review I did not, to tell the truth, know what I was getting into or where I would end up. Still full of optimism, before reading it myself I approached the author and asked him to send me his biographical details, since there are none in the book and it would be as well to know whose book I was about to review. I received a one-line answer: that the author is a man from Prešov, a little older than me, with a technical education. I later discovered that the last two words of that answer cover a considerably broad field.

The absence of any information whatsoever about the author has its point. It is not that he is making himself mysterious. But once the Arabs learn from this book that Allah (Alah/Alach) is in fact a Valach, a Wallachian, and that the Arabs too are Slavs, they will certainly declare a fatwa against him for insulting the faith. A somewhat unoriginal way of becoming famous.

I read the book very attentively, took notes and underlined whole passages of the text. After finishing it I spent another month thinking about what to write, and several times I made an embarrassed start.

children.text: Read the rest of the article at this address: HISTORYWEB
Please do not believe every piece of nonsense merely because it creates a flattering picture of the Slavs. If that picture has no real foundation, we are only deceiving ourselves.

blocks.alt: So they are suppressing our history again...

children.text: The motto of our website reads:
“Let us be proud of our history. We have many reasons to be”
Perhaps it is time to add a small rider to this motto of ours:
“And we do not have to invent it”

Without false modesty, I believe that our portal www.hradiska.sk is trying to do a good deal for the rediscovery and popularisation of our glorious Slavic history. And we can manage it without senseless fantasies.
